name: Percy
source:
Percy, on the other hand, is always there at the right time to defend Kai. His kind, yet over-protective title led him to become Kai's best friend. For all these years, Percy has yearned to be something more than friends, but his attempts so far have been futile.

Likes: Exercise, Plants
Dislikes: Insects, Gavain

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/my-nemesis-and-hero]itch.io[/url]]
